2: 
3: Milestone: P2 — MVP / Core Features

6: Surfaces: backend

10: 
11: As a compliance auditor, I want security and domain mutations across iam, configuration, execution, and governance to commit sanitized audit entries and in-app or SMTP notifications via AuditEventPort and NotificationPort, and the dashboard aggregator to query live counts via ExecutionDashboardReadPort and GovernanceDashboardReadPort, so that cross-context auditability and operational alerts are complete.

16: Kind: happy

18: When security and domain mutations execute across `iam` (session login/logout, role/p

91: - **BSP (Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas) Circular 982 / 1019 (IT Risk Management & Financial Audit Trail Controls)**: Mandates a complete, tamper-evident, append-only 13-month online audit trail (`audit_log_entries` guarded by `trg_audit_log_entries_immutable`) across all IAM, configuration, report execution, and maker-checker governance actions, capturing actor workspace email, effective `View-As` role, event type, resource identifier, outcome, correlation ID, search queries (`search_query_text`), and sanitized JSON mutation payloads (`mutation_payload_json`), alongside timely operational alerts and live dashboard monitoring of open runs, pending approvals, and failed scheduled jobs.
92: - **Philippines Data Privacy Act of 2012 (RA 10173) & GDPR**: Requires least-privilege RBAC over compliance audit logs (`AUDIT_LOGS_READ`), strict BOLA recipient isolation on personal in-app notifications (`recipient_user_id = principal.userId()`), self-auditing of compliance log searches (`AUDIT_LOG_SEARCHED`), and redaction of credentials/secrets/tokens from `mutation_payload_json`.
93: - **Internal GXI Enterprise Governance & Security Baseline (`security-baseline.mdc` §1, §2, §3, §8, §11, §12 & VAPT F4, F8, F9, F10)**: Mandates fail-closed session and route authorization, BOLA recipient checks on `/api/v1/notifications/{id}/**`, `View-As` read-only mutation blocking (`VIEW_AS_MUTATION_FORBIDDEN`), `Encode.forJava()` sanitization on all persisted audit and notification fields, preservation of refusal audit logs on rolled-back transactions (`@Transactional(noRollbackFor = ContractProblemException.class)`), and bounded asynchronous SMTP retry (`5` attempts) with `FAILED_DLQ` dead-letter isolation.
